properties.abstract:
Apache Avro is a binary serialization framework with support for maps, arrays, records, enums, union types and a whole range of primitives. It's similar to Protobuf or Thrift, but better supported by the tools our data scientists know and love. Unfortunately, the runtime representation of Avro records is mutable and mostly relies on casting Objects to the desired type. Nitro will be open sourcing avro-codegen, an SBT plugin we’ve been using internally to generate immutable case classes from Avro schemas. This talk will explain how to use avro-codegen and take a quick look at the implementation.
Paul Kinsky is a Senior Platform Engineer at Nitro.
properties.title: Generating Immutable Case Classes from Avro Schemas
Scala By the Bay Meetup at Nitro: FP meets ML
